+On the consumer, the body of a chunked request is an `InputStream` only when the route runs on the executor
+service (`usingExecutorService=true`, the default), as the body cannot be received while the route waits for it
+on the I/O thread; otherwise the request is aggregated as any other. The stream is closed when the exchange is done,
+and the part of the body that the route did not read is discarded. When the reply is streamed (its body is an
+`InputStream`), the stream is closed once the reply is written instead, as the reply may read it (the request body sent
+back, as it is or in another stream); such a reply reads it on the I/O thread, so the body must be received already.

`NettySharedHttpServerBootstrapConfiguration` and started on its own. The consumers that refer to it with the
`nettySharedHttpServer` option use its port and its pipeline, instead of the server that the component creates.

+the route is called (the `chunked` option of `NettySharedHttpServerBootstrapConfiguration` is not used).
